indicator_name: GDP and GVA volume index by section for the discrete quarter, same quarter of previous year = 100 (derived from year-to-date data)
description: ИФО ВВП и ВДС по видам деятельности за отдельный квартал, к тому же кварталу прошлого года (выведено из нарастающих итогов)
unit: % of the same quarter of the previous year
methodology: Derived from GVA_VOLUME_INDEX_BY_SECTION_QUARTERLY and GVA_NOMINAL_BY_SECTION_QUARTERLY: I_k = (I_ytd,k·N_ytd,k,t−1 − I_ytd,k−1·N_ytd,k−1,t−1)/(N_ytd,k,t−1 − N_ytd,k−1,t−1), previous-year prices. Gives the latest quarter before BNS's quarterly accounts (the expenditure QNA, element 283161, published 2026 Q2 on 04.11.2026: GDP 108.2 % y/y against 105.2 here, H1 105.1 against 104.1, Q1 revised to 101.4 against 103.0 -- the two bases split the half-year differently; the production QNA ends at 2025 Q4 since BNS withdrew its 2026 columns on 20.10.2026: source_issues qna_production_2026_withdrawn). Rounding band about ±0.15 pp for GDP; Q4 carries the annual-survey residual of table 4439; the 4439/4440 basis differs from the QNA basis -- do not splice without a note. 2026 Q2: GDP 105.2.
